findings.problem: Heading uses 'white space'. The guideline must use one form, 'whitespace'.
Caption uses 'white spaces'. Use 'whitespace' as in the rest of the guideline.
findings.original: Expandable text with preserved white spaces

findings.problem: Accessibility must name keyboard, screen reader and contrast information. Contrast is missing.
findings.original: Keyboard interaction is supported through the Show More / Show Less link, which follows the keyboard behavior of the Link component.
findings.fix: Keyboard interaction is supported through the Show More / Show Less link, which follows the keyboard behavior of the Link component. The link meets the contrast requirements of WCAG 2.1 for text and interactive elements.

findings.problem: Uses 'the user' in general text. Address the reader as 'you'.
'making it easier to read and interact' judges usability instead of describing behavior.
findings.original: making it easier to read and interact with the content
findings.fix: so that the content is displayed in full

findings.problem: Term 'expand text link' is inconsistent with the defined 'Show More' link.
findings.original: positioned relative to the expand text link
findings.fix: positioned relative to the Show More link

findings.problem: 'Learn More' is not a descriptive link text. It must say where the link goes.
findings.fix: See the SAPUI5 and SAP Web Components guidelines.
